fn drain(control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
    // A comment with a brace { and a loop keyword: loop { while
    let available = control.available_at_entry(); // trailing { comment
    for _ in 0..available {
        // }
        let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
            break;
        };
        apply(record, "{ while loop }");
    }
}
